votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of March 23, 2021; April 6, 2021; January 4, 2022; January 11, 2022; February 1, 2022 as well as the formal meeting minutes of April 20, 2021; June 8, 2021; August 17, 2021; January 18, 2022 as well as the minutes for the January 3, 2022 Oath of Office Ceremony and the January 25, 2022 Council retreat.
votes.description: Approval of multiple work session, formal meeting, oath of office, and retreat minutes spanning March 2021 through February 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 4 of 2022, Joint Ceremonial Resolution Recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall formally recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Continue public hearing on Ordinance: Budget Amendment No. 6 for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
votes.description: The Council voted to continue the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 6 for FY 2021-22, which includes funding for new Arts Council employees, a second SVU sergeant, and additional Emergency Rental Assistance Program funding.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance: Rezone and Master Plan Amendment for the Former Fire Station No. 3 Property.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and deferred action on the proposed rezone of properties at 1085, 1095, 1097 East Simpson Avenue and 1104 East Sugarmont Drive from PL to CSHBD1 and related Sugar House Community Plan amendment.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance: Rezone at 1193 West California Avenue.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and deferred action on the proposed rezone of 1193 West California Avenue from R-1/7,000 to R-1/5,000 to allow future subdivision and construction of two new homes.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance: Rezone at 2060 North 2200 West.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and deferred action on the proposed rezone of 2060 North 2200 West from AG-2 to M-1 to implement master plan zoning and accommodate future commercial land uses.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 4 of 2022: Budget Amendment No. 4 for Fiscal Year 2021-22, only for item E-2: Emergency Winter Overflow Shelter Lease Payment Support.
votes.description: The Council adopted a limited portion of Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY 2021-22, specifically funding for the emergency winter overflow shelter lease payment support.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 5 of 2022 formally establishing the Accessibility and Disability Commission.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending the Salt Lake City Code to formalize the Accessibility and Disability Commission, recognizing its advisory role in improving accessibility for community members with disabilities.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda with the exclusion of Item No. 2.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates, board appointments, and reappointments, excluding the rezone item at 1583 East Stratford Avenue.
